retirement_age.notes: No single national statutory retirement age was found. Most central government employees retire at 60 under Fundamental Rule 56; State government ages vary by state (commonly 56 to 62), and judges have constitutional ages (Supreme Court 65, High Court 62). As of July 2026 no nationwide change had been announced. Elected offices such as President, Prime Minister and members of Parliament have no retirement age.

open_questions: Retirement age: no statutory national age for all citizens/public office found; statutory left null. The 60-year figure for central government staff comes from a secondary source (Keka); the official DoPT / Fundamental Rule 56 text was not retrieved in this run.
